responsibility: This header declares the mc-boot runtime's basic raw-memory helper procedures. It exports the interfaces for copying a memory region and zeroing a memory region, defining the public low-level utilities used below higher-level string and storage abstractions.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the interface half of the GMemUtils pair: it declares MemCopy and MemZero and exposes the low-level API, while gcc/m2/mc-boot/GMemUtils.cc contains the concrete memory-copy and zero-fill implementations.
